_source: Concept-level template, aligned 2026-08-16 to a practitioner's online BIA/BCP system (2012–2017, banking; shared in confidence — anonymised, no company or person names) as walked through in the 13.08.2026 call, and to GPG PP3 / ISO 22317. Stage 3 fills this from the stage-2 capture: the spoken word becomes a table with numbers. Impact categories and horizons are defaults — method.json per company overrides.
_rules: Requirements are recorded PER ACTIVITY (ISO 22317, GPG PP3); the department roll-up (skeleton staff per horizon, recovery seats total, application list) is a stage-5 view for consolidation, not the record.
priority_tier is derived from the impact grid (earliest horizon at which any category reaches the intolerability threshold gives the tier; lowest tier = not time-critical) — never asserted.
skeleton_staff per horizon and seats_needed may not exceed the department headcount — flag, do not silently accept.

it_actual_rto / it_actual_rpo are OPTIONAL reference values from an IT register when the company has one; a requirement stricter than the actual is flagged as a capability gap for solution design (GPG PP4) — flagged, never resolved in the BIA.
Dependencies on other departments are the counterpart's obligation: each entry should surface in that department's BIA (what is exchanged, by when, the alternative if it fails).

The 'suitable for' recovery options are the interviewee's view of what could work (work from home, transfer to another team/site, alternative site seat, staff relocation, manual workaround) — input to strategy, not a decision.

validation.role: head of department | division lead | country lead

resource_requirements.other_requirements: documents, terminals, seals/stamps, shared drives, equipment

department_rollup._note: stage-5 view, computed from the activities: never edited by hand
